text:
jamie: Quick sync — customer asks keep strong tenant affinity for latency-sensitive routes. need to weigh cost + launch gates. who wants to surface tradeoffs?

sri: short version: affinity reduces cross-region hops but multiplies capacity footprints. ~1.6x cost for strict per-tenant pools vs pooled lanes.

leila: numbers look right from infra sim. Also adds headroom frag for autoscale — cold start risk unless we do small shared buffers.

matt: customer's ask is SLA 99.9 for inference p95, low jitter. They'll pay more but want clear pricing bands.

jamie: proposal: three tiers — public pooled (default), affinity-lite (soft-affinity, >90% local routing), and strict-dedicated for enterprise with reserved capacity + SLA. launch criteria per tier?

leila: launch gates: infra tests (multi-region failover), capacity pack provisioning, billing integration, KMS audit for Private. Also migration tooling for moving tenants between tiers.

sri: can we get away with soft-affinity by sticky routing + prefix KV cache warmers? That'd hit most latency wins without 2x cost. fallback policy: if local capacity saturated, spill to pooled lane with higher cost tag.

jamie: sounds promising. Need clear KPIs: p95 latency delta (local vs spill), cost per 1M tokens, failed fallbacks rate. define thresholds for auto-escalation.

taylor: ops concern: observability must include per-tenant routing histograms and rollback playbook. If affinity causes noisy neighbor, we need quick quarantine path.

matt: commercial asks — standard SLA language + uplift pricing for strict-dedicated. sales wants a migration checklist to present to customers.

jamie: next steps — sri & leila run a 2-week sim: cost vs p95 for soft-affinity heuristics. taylor to draft rollback playbook. i'll collate launch gates and customer-facing pricing blurb. matt, loop in top 3 customers for feedback. target sync in 2 weeks. :calendar:

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for <@jamie> in 14 days

sri: noted — I'll include config proto for routing policy. snippet below for discussion:
```
policy: {
  affinity_mode: SOFT,
  spill_policy: "POOL_PRIORITY",
  cache_warm: true,
  max_local_reserve_pct: 60
}
```

jamie: perfect. thanks all — I'll drop a short RFC draft in #architecture-rfcs before next sync.
